blurb: Bear Valley Adventure Company rents high-end mountain bikes, kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, and provides boat delivery services on local reservoirs. They also operate a mountain bike shop and host various community events including triathlons, pickleball and tennis lessons, and trail maintenance days. Their store sells camping, fishing, biking, boating gear, clothing, snacks, and beverages.
extraNote: Bikes must be in good working order to sell at bike swap · Bike swap sellers pay 20% commission to BVAC · Unsold bikes must be retrieved within two weeks or $100 handling fee applies
